attributes.name: Corrupted Crusaders
attributes.powers:
Before you act, draw a random ally from the box and display it next to your scenario.

Each character at your location summons and encounters the henchman Corrupted Soldier. The barrier is defeated only if you defeat your henchman; otherwise, it is undefeated. If any Corrupted Soldiers were not defeated, banish the displayed ally; otherwise, add it to your hand.

corrections.corrected_text: On the barriers Arboreal Blight and Corrupted Crusaders, replace "The barrier is defeated or undefeated based solely on your encounter" with "The barrier is defeated only if you defeat your henchman; otherwise, it is undefeated". (Note: These cards also appear in the Character Add-On Deck.)
corrections.issue: Arboreal Blight and Corrupted Crusaders are defeated or undefeated based on the result of an encounter with a summoned henchman. What happens if I evade that summoned henchman?
